import os, ctypes, torch, time, math
from torch.profiler import profile, ProfilerActivity
import b200probe
print('persist', os.path.exists('/tmp/convblk/libcb.so'))
lib = ctypes.CDLL('/tmp/convblk/libcb.so')
lib.convblk_ws_bytes.restype = ctypes.c_size_t
lib.convblk_ws_bytes.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int]*4
lib.convblk_run.restype = ctypes.c_int
lib.convblk_counts.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int]*4 + [ctypes.c_void_p]
dev='cuda'
shapes=[(1,192,28,28),(1,96,56,56),(1,160,449,7),(2,96,56,56),(4,192,28,28),(8,384,14,14),(4,96,56,56),(8,192,28,28),(16,384,14,14),(2,768,7,7),(8,768,7,7),(16,768,7,7),(8,320,32,32),(32,768,7,7),(32,128,64,64),(64,96,112,112)]
import sys
sel = [s for s in shapes]
def mk(B,C,H,W):
    g=lambda *s: torch.randn(*s,device=dev)
    return dict(x=g(B,C,H,W), dww=g(C,1,7,7)/7**.5, dwb=g(C), lnw=torch.ones(C,device=dev), lnb=torch.zeros(C,device=dev),
      w1=g(4*C,C)/C**.5, b1=g(4*C), gw=g(4*C)/(2*C)**.5, gb=g(4*C), w2=g(C,4*C)/(2*C)**.5, b2=g(C), out=torch.zeros(B,C,H,W,device=dev))
P=lambda t: ctypes.c_void_p(t.data_ptr())
def run(d,ws,B,C,H,W):
    rc = lib.convblk_run(P(d['x']),P(d['dww']),P(d['dwb']),P(d['lnw']),P(d['lnb']),P(d['w1']),P(d['b1']),P(d['gw']),P(d['gb']),P(d['w2']),P(d['b2']),P(d['out']),P(ws),
        ctypes.c_int(B),ctypes.c_int(C),ctypes.c_int(H),ctypes.c_int(W),ctypes.c_float(1e-6),ctypes.c_float(1e-6),ctypes.c_void_p(torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream))
    assert rc==0, rc
def prof(d,ws,B,C,H,W):
    b200probe.flush_l2(); torch.cuda.synchronize()
    with profile(activities=[ProfilerActivity.CUDA]) as p:
        run(d,ws,B,C,H,W); torch.cuda.synchronize()
    ev=[e for e in p.events() if e.device_type.name=='CUDA']
    ev.sort(key=lambda e:e.time_range.start)
    return [(e.name, e.time_range.elapsed_us()) for e in ev]
def tag(n):
    for k,t in (('k1_dwln','K1'),('k2_gelu','K2'),('k3a','K3a'),('k3b','K3b')):
        if k in n: return t
    return 'G'
for (B,C,H,W) in sel:
    cnt=(ctypes.c_int*8)(); lib.convblk_counts(B,C,H,W,cnt)
    d=mk(B,C,H,W); wb=lib.convblk_ws_bytes(B,C,H,W); ws=torch.empty(wb,dtype=torch.uint8,device=dev)
    res=[]
    for i in range(3):
        lib.convblk_set_idx(i,i)
        run(d,ws,B,C,H,W); torch.cuda.synchronize()
        r=prof(d,ws,B,C,H,W)
        res.append(r)
    r0=res[0]
    s=' '.join(f"{tag(n)}={t:.1f}" for n,t in r0)
    g1=[ [t for n,t in r if tag(n)=='G'] for r in res]
    print((B,C,H,W),'nal',list(cnt)[:2],'RT',cnt[2],'TB',cnt[3],'tiles',cnt[4],'nrole',cnt[5],'bB',cnt[6],'smemK',cnt[7],'|',s,'| G by idx',[[round(x,1) for x in g] for g in g1])
    sys.stdout.flush()
    del d, ws
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()

import os, ctypes, torch, subprocess, time, sys
import b200probe
src = open('/tmp/convblk/kernel.cu').read()
def patch(s):
    s = s.replace("for (int cl = warp * 32; cl < warp * 32 + 32; ++cl) {", "for (int cl = warp * 32; (!NOSTAGE_) && cl < warp * 32 + 32; ++cl) {")
    s = s.replace("for (int e = tid; e < TB * 49; e += TB) {", "for (int e = tid; (!NOSTAGE_) && e < TB * 49; e += TB) {")
    s = s.replace("for (int r = 0; r < rows; ++r) {", "for (int r = 0; (!NOCOMP_) && r < rows; ++r) {")
    s = s.replace("for (int tk = warp; tk < ntok; tk += nw) {", "for (int tk = warp; (!NOLN_) && tk < ntok; tk += nw) {")
    s = s.replace("{ k1_role(p, blockIdx.x, tid, TB); return; }", "{ if (!NOROLE_) k1_role(p, blockIdx.x, tid, TB); return; }")
    s = s.replace("static int g_idx1 = 0, g_idx2 = 0;", "static int g_idx1 = 0, g_idx2 = 0, g_mask = 5;\nextern \"C\" void convblk_set_mask(int m) { g_mask = m; }")
    s = s.replace("  const float alpha = 1.f, beta0 = 0.f, beta1 = 1.f;", "  if (g_mask < 2) return 0;\n  const float alpha = 1.f, beta0 = 0.f, beta1 = 1.f;")
    s = s.replace("  const int nb = (P->HW + P->tokb - 1) / P->tokb;", "  if (g_mask < 3) return 0;\n  const int nb = (P->HW + P->tokb - 1) / P->tokb;")
    s = s.replace("  if (P->bB) k3b_scale<<<", "  if (g_mask < 4) return 0;\n  if (P->bB) k3b_scale<<<")
    s = s.replace("  CB(cublasLtMatmul(g_lt, P->md2,", "  if (g_mask < 5) return 0;\n  CB(cublasLtMatmul(g_lt, P->md2,")
    s = s.replace("  CK(cudaGetLastError());\n  const float alpha", "  CK(cudaGetLastError());\n  if (g_mask < 2) return 0;\n  const float alpha") if False else s
    return s
def build(name, flags):
    open(f'/tmp/convblk/{name}.cu','w').write(patch(src))
    d = ' '.join(f'-D{k}={v}' for k,v in flags.items())
    pre = "#ifndef NOSTAGE_\n#define NOSTAGE_ 0\n#endif\n#ifndef NOCOMP_\n#define NOCOMP_ 0\n#endif\n#ifndef NOLN_\n#define NOLN_ 0\n#endif\n#ifndef NOROLE_\n#define NOROLE_ 0\n#endif\n"
    open(f'/tmp/convblk/{name}.cu','w').write(pre+patch(src))
    r=subprocess.run(f"cd /tmp/convblk && nvcc -O3 --use_fast_math -std=c++17 -gencode arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a -shared -Xcompiler -fPIC --cudart shared {name}.cu -o {name}.so -lcublasLt {d}",shell=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
    if r.returncode: print(r.stderr[-800:]); raise SystemExit
    lib = ctypes.CDLL(f'/tmp/convblk/{name}.so')
    lib.convblk_ws_bytes.restype = ctypes.c_size_t; lib.convblk_ws_bytes.argtypes=[ctypes.c_int]*4
    return lib
dev='cuda'
P=lambda t: ctypes.c_void_p(t.data_ptr())
def mk(B,C,H,W):
    g=lambda *s: torch.randn(*s,device=dev)
    return [g(B,C,H,W), g(C,1,7,7)/7**.5, g(C), torch.ones(C,device=dev), torch.zeros(C,device=dev), g(4*C,C)/C**.5, g(4*C), g(4*C)/(2*C)**.5, g(4*C), g(C,4*C)/(2*C)**.5, g(C)], [torch.zeros(B,C,H,W,device=dev)]
def timeit(lib, B,C,H,W, mask):
    ins, outs = mk(B,C,H,W)
    wb=lib.convblk_ws_bytes(B,C,H,W); ws=torch.empty(wb,dtype=torch.uint8,device=dev)
    lib.convblk_set_mask(mask)
    st = ctypes.c_void_p(torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream)
    def f(x,dww,dwb,lnw,lnb,w1,b1,gw,gb,w2,b2,out):
        rc=lib.convblk_run(P(x),P(dww),P(dwb),P(lnw),P(lnb),P(w1),P(b1),P(gw),P(gb),P(w2),P(b2),P(out),P(ws),ctypes.c_int(B),ctypes.c_int(C),ctypes.c_int(H),ctypes.c_int(W),ctypes.c_float(1e-6),ctypes.c_float(1e-6),st)
        assert rc==0
    return b200probe.harness_time(f, ins, outs)
shapes=[(1,96,56,56),(4,192,28,28),(2,768,7,7),(8,320,32,32)]
variants=[('base',{}),('nostage',{'NOSTAGE_':1}),('nocomp',{'NOCOMP_':1}),('noln',{'NOLN_':1}),('norole',{'NOROLE_':1}),('nostage_nocomp_noln',{'NOSTAGE_':1,'NOCOMP_':1,'NOLN_':1})]
for nm,fl in variants:
    lib=build(nm,fl)
    lib.convblk_set_mask.argtypes=[ctypes.c_int]
    print(nm, [round(timeit(lib,*s,1),1) for s in shapes]); sys.stdout.flush()
# cumulative launches for base
lib=ctypes.CDLL('/tmp/convblk/base.so'); lib.convblk_ws_bytes.restype=ctypes.c_size_t; lib.convblk_ws_bytes.argtypes=[ctypes.c_int]*4
for s in shapes+[(32,768,7,7),(32,128,64,64)]:
    print(s,'cum K1,G1,K2,K3,G2:',[round(timeit(lib,*s,m),1) for m in (1,2,3,4,5)]); sys.stdout.flush()

import torch, b200probe
dev='cuda'
res=[]
for (m,k,n) in [(784,192,768),(784,768,192),(98,768,3072),(98,3072,768),(1568,768,3072),(8192,320,1280),(8192,1280,320),(131072,128,512),(802816,96,384)]:
    out=[]
    for dt,tf in ((torch.float16,False),(torch.float32,True)):
        torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32=tf
        a=torch.randn(m,k,device=dev,dtype=dt); w=torch.randn(n,k,device=dev,dtype=dt); o=torch.empty(m,n,device=dev,dtype=dt)
        out.append(round(b200probe.harness_time(lambda a,w,o: torch.matmul(a,w.t(),out=o),[a,w],[o]),1))
        del a,w,o
    res.append(((m,k,n),'fp16/tf32 us',out))
for r in res: print(r)
ksrc=r'''
extern "C" __global__ void wr(uint4* s, long n16) { for (long i = blockIdx.x*(long)blockDim.x+threadIdx.x; i<n16; i+=(long)gridDim.x*blockDim.x) s[i] = make_uint4(i,i,i,i); }
extern "C" __global__ void rd(const uint4* s, long n16, float* o) { unsigned acc=0; for (long i = blockIdx.x*(long)blockDim.x+threadIdx.x; i<n16; i+=(long)gridDim.x*blockDim.x) { uint4 v=s[i]; acc ^= v.x^v.y^v.z^v.w; } if (acc==0x12345678u) o[0]=1.f; }
'''
kw=b200probe.cuda_kernel(ksrc,'wr'); kr=b200probe.cuda_kernel(ksrc,'rd')
o=torch.zeros(1024,device=dev)
for mb in (0.01,20,42,134):
    n=int(mb*1e6)//16*16; sc=torch.zeros(max(n,16),dtype=torch.uint8,device=dev)
    f=lambda sc,o,n=n: (kw((592,),(256,),sc,n//16), kr((592,),(256,),sc,n//16,o))
    print('H16 scratch',mb,'MB write+read:',round(b200probe.harness_time(f,[sc],[o]),2),'us; ideal @7TB/s', round(2*n/7e6,1))
